title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: A team ritual
hook: Does your team have a ritual they look forward to?
intro: Practice starts and ends the same way.
statement: A small ritual helps a group feel like a team.
q1: Do you build a team cheer or ritual together —
q2: or keep things simple with no rituals?
q3: What would your players come up with?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids feel connected
t2: when the team has something that is theirs.
cta: Coaches — does your team have a ritual?
ctaLines: A cheer. A handshake. A song before games.
ctaPrompt: Share your team ritual below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Does your team have a ritual they look forward to?
Practice starts and ends the same way. Kids just go through it.
A small ritual helps a group feel like a team.
A team ritual or keep it simple. Both can work.
Does your team have a ritual? Share your habit in the comments.
